first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person whose hands and forearms are visible from a first-person perspective, wearing brown fingerless gloves and beige long sleeves.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A painted, short cylindrical throwable held in Person A's right hand; its exposed body is brown, with a blue-green band, yellow dots, and a dark top mechanism.

entities.name: arched wooden double doors
entities.identification: Two gray-brown wooden doors in the beige arched entrance, with dark horizontal strips and an opening left in the center.

entities.name: group of wooden crates outside the gate
entities.identification: A group of light-colored wooden crates on the image-left side in front of the doors, including a larger worn wooden crate and a light-gray crate with dark framing strips.

entities.name: blue-green metal barrel
entities.identification: A group of barrels lying horizontally at the base of the wall on the image-right side of the wooden doors, including a blue-green barrel in front and a blue-gray barrel behind it.

entities.name: light-brown courtyard road
entities.identification: A bright light-brown road visible through the central opening behind the double doors.

entities.name: red arrow-and-letter wall marking
entities.identification: A red upward-pointing arrow and the uppercase letter B on the wall on the image-right side of the wooden doors.

entities.name: overhead power lines
entities.identification: Multiple thin, dark power lines running diagonally across the upper part of the opening against the bright background behind the doors.

entities.name: beige entrance wall
entities.identification: The beige wall and arched doorframe surrounding the wooden doors; the wall corner on the image-left side is curved, and the surface has mottled stains.

entities.name: light-colored entrance ground
entities.identification: The light gray-brown ground in front of the doors, with a raised slope and curb on the image-right side and worn patches and shadows on its surface.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: The background vegetation, including the green tree canopy at the upper right at the beginning and the yellow-green palm leaves visible through the gap between the doors in the final frame.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The pale blue to nearly white sky visible above the top of the wall and within the opening between the doors.
